claim: The Analysis Group study was funded by Apple ('Support for this study was provided by Apple'), though the authors state the conclusions are exclusively their own -- an important disclosure for weighing the study's framing of the '90% commission-free' statistic.
stance_target: Independence and reliability of the Analysis Group ecosystem study
scope_conditions: Study published June 2026, covering calendar year 2025
quoted_support: Support for this study was provided by Apple. The conclusions and opinions expressed are exclusively those of the authors.

claim: Apple does not collect commission on digital purchases initiated outside apps, on physical goods/services purchased through apps, or on in-app ad revenue -- meaning the vast majority of the $1.4 trillion 'ecosystem' figure was never part of Apple's commissionable base regardless of any regulatory action, and citing the 90%-commission-free statistic as evidence of regulatory-driven erosion is a category error.
stance_target: The 90%-commission-free statistic demonstrates recent regulatory erosion of Apple's contingent App Store commission revenue
scope_conditions: Global App Store ecosystem methodology, 2025 study
quoted_support: Apple does not collect a commission on purchases of digital goods and services that are initiated outside of apps..., on purchases of physical goods and services through apps..., or on in-app ad revenue.
numbers: $149 billion true commissionable digital goods/services base (2025)

claim: The Analysis Group study series has retroactively updated prior years' per-category figures for accuracy in each new edition, so year-over-year comparisons of the App Store ecosystem across different editions of this same study series should be treated cautiously rather than as a consistent time series.
stance_target: Reliability of citing this study series for multi-year trend analysis
scope_conditions: Analysis Group App Store ecosystem study series, 2019-2025 editions
quoted_support: Due to retroactive changes made to third-party data sources, some numbers in this report have been updated for accuracy and may differ from previous studies.
